dispatch.headline: Tycho Mayor Who Faked Clumsiness Dies
dispatch.body:
Former Mayor Toby Haze, who governed Tycho Rim for thirty years by constantly spilling soup on his shoes, died on Monday. He was eighty-four.

Haze rose from airlock technician to district mayor on a platform of pure awkwardness. While upper-dome politicians spoke with sleek grace, Haze dropped his voting wands, tripped over door sills, and tangled his jacket in air valves during speeches. Voters trusted a man who could not manage his own sleeves. He won six straight elections.

His career ended during his seventh campaign. A leaked recording revealed that his famous clumsiness was choreographed by top decorum consultants from the upper gardens.

The tapes showed Haze rehearsing a trip over a power line for forty minutes. His coaches corrected his posture whenever he fell too gracefully.

"A poor man falls with his elbows tucked," said his lead coach, Kaelen Voss. "Toby kept landing like a dancer, so we had to break his poise."

Public trust collapsed instantly. Citizens forgave his budget deficits, but they could not forgive his hidden elegance. In his final election, voters rejected him for a logistics clerk who had never once dropped a spoon.

Haze spent his final years indoors. Neighbours reported that he walked with a crisp, perfect stride that everyone found deeply offensive. His memorial service will be held in the lower basin. Attendees are asked to walk carefully.
dispatch.scene: Former Mayor Toby Haze lies sprawled on the polished stone floor of a domed council chamber with soup spilled across his shoes, while seated officials at a long table look away.
dispatch.premise: Obituary for Mayor Haze, who built a thirty-year career in Tycho Dome on calculated, working-class clumsiness, until his reelection campaign imploded when a leaked recording exposed his staged awkwardness as being choreographed by elite decorum consultants.

brief.subject: Former Mayor Toby Haze, an elderly man wearing a high-collared dark blue tunic, matching dark trousers, and leather boots splattered with thick yellow soup
brief.action: lying flat on his back on the floor with an overturned ceramic bowl resting beside his shoulder
brief.setting: the polished grey granite floor of a circular domed council chamber, with three council officials seated at a long raised wooden desk in the background facing away from him
brief.light: diffuse white light shining directly down from recessed circular panels in the domed ceiling
brief.materials: polished granite, smooth wool blend fabric, dark polished hardwood, ceramic
brief.anomaly: a scuffed brass cable access hatch in the floor sitting slightly ajar near the edge of the spill

quality.judge_reason: It sharply satirises manufactured political relatability with a brilliant quote from a 'decorum consultant' training a politician to fall clumsily.
quality.critique: The original headline described the premise rather than landing a punchline, and the quote lacked absurd commitment. The final line restated the setup instead of escalating the joke.
